description: Reverse-ETL sink: upload one evidence file into Vanta per row of an upstream DataFrame (POST /v1/documents -> POST /v1/documents/{id}/uploads -> POST /v1/documents/{id}/submit). Push-path write component -- pairs with vanta_controls_ingestion (read) and vanta_evidence_response_agent (LLM narrative drafting).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one document+upload(+submit) sequence in Vanta.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (documents_created / uploads_succeeded / documents_submitted / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Vanta.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

resource_key.description: Resource key registered by VantaResourceComponent. Must be configured with write/upload scopes.
resource_key.label: Resource Key

document_id_column.label: Document Id Column
document_id_column.description: Upstream column holding an existing Vanta document id. When present, document creation is skipped and the file is uploaded straight to that document.

document_name_column.label: Document Name Column
document_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the document title (used as title when creating a new document).

document_name.label: Document Name
document_name.description: Static fallback document title, used when document_name_column is unset or a row's value is empty.

evidence_description_column.label: Evidence Description Column
evidence_description_column.description: Upstream column holding a human-readable description of the evidence (sent as both the document's description on create and the upload's description).

file_path_column.label: File Path Column
file_path_column.description: Upstream column holding a local filesystem path to the evidence file. Mutually exclusive with file_content_column.

file_content_column.label: File Content Column
file_content_column.description: Upstream column holding inline file content -- base64-encoded text by convention. Mutually exclusive with file_path_column.

file_name_column.label: File Name Column
file_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the filename to upload as.

mime_type_column.label: Mime Type Column
mime_type_column.description: Upstream column holding an explicit MIME type override.

mime_type.label: Mime Type
mime_type.description: Static MIME type override, used when mime_type_column is unset or empty for a row.

effective_at_date_column.label: Effective At Date Column
effective_at_date_column.description: Upstream column holding an ISO-8601 date for the upload's effectiveAtDate.

reminder_window.label: Reminder Window
reminder_window.description: Notification lead time before renewal (ISO-8601 duration).

is_sensitive.label: Is Sensitive
is_sensitive.description: Whether the document holds sensitive data requiring restricted access.

auto_submit.label: Auto Submit
auto_submit.description: Whether to call POST /v1/documents/{id}/submit after a successful upload.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: HTTP timeout for each Vanta API call.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Vanta Evidence Upload
